source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 7 January 1924, p. 7 ("List of nominations: many Labour candidates in the field"); Belfast News-Letter, 16 January 1924, p. 7 ("Belfast municipal elections: the results")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Annual election of one councillor in each of the 15 wards of Belfast Corporation (the member retiring in rotation), nominations Saturday 5 January, poll Tuesday 15 January 1924. Ten wards were contested; Falls, St Anne's, Shankill, Smithfield and Windsor returned their members unopposed (Belfast News-Letter, 7 and 16 January 1924). Labour gained Court and Dock, and an Independent Unionist St George's. Returned unopposed.
